:::{#def-error-rate}
#### Error rate (misclassification rate)

The **error rate** of a [fitted model](#def-fitted-model) $\fitted$
for a categorical outcome on a set of observations
is the proportion of those observations whose predicted category differs from the observed category.
It is the sample mean [loss](#def-observation-loss) under 0-1 loss,
$\lossf{\outvar, \hat{\outvar}} = \indic{\outvar \neq \hat{\outvar}}$,
which is 1 for a wrong prediction and 0 for a correct one.
The [training error](#def-training-mse) with this loss is the *training error rate*,
and the [test error](#def-test-error) with this loss is the *test error rate*.

:::
